_comment: Example config for traitors-mobile (Mode B simulation). Copy to config.json and edit. Every section/key is optional -- omitted keys use the built-in defaults. The Claude API key is NEVER stored here: it is read from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable at runtime (e.g. `source ~/.hermes/.env` before running). Provider options: claude | ollama | mock (mock = deterministic dry run, no network).
